consequence.statement: CiliumNetworkPolicies with multiple L7 protocols on the same port, over 40 port rules, or over 40 ICMP rules, previously ignored, are now rejected by the apiserver.
consequence.remediation: Fix or remove such invalid CiliumNetworkPolicies before applying them.

assertion.statement: Invalid CiliumNetworkPolicies (multiple L7 protocols on the same port, over 40 port rules, or over 40 ICMP rules) that were previously ignored are now rejected by the apiserver via server-side validation.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Exposure depends on whether existing policies have multiple L7 protocols on one port or over 40 port/ICMP rules; exact schema paths are not stated in the evidence.
